AWS.label: yes
AWS.note: Audit Manager report plans deliver daily/scheduled reports to your Amazon S3 bucket (CSV/JSON).

Acronis.label: yes
Acronis.note: Reports can be scheduled and sent by email to recipients or saved to a folder (.xlsx).

Afi.ai.label: yes
Afi.ai.note: Periodic status reports delivered via email, Slack, Teams or Google Chat.

Arcserve.label: yes
Arcserve.note: UDP scheduled report emails; ShadowControl schedules standard report to recipients daily/weekly/monthly.

Arctera.label: yes
Arctera.note: Reports can be scheduled on a recurring schedule with email notification including a copy of the report.

Atempo.label: yes
Atempo.note: Lina reports can be submitted automatically daily/weekly/monthly to email recipients (attachment, URL link or embedded table).

AvePoint.label: yes
AvePoint.note: Elements can export and send reports to recipients on a schedule (Excel workbook by email).

Axcient.label: yes
Axcient.note: Report definitions delivered by email on a daily/weekly/monthly schedule; scheduled delivery of executive summary reports.

Bacula.label: unclear
Bacula.note: Only a third-party script (baculabackupreport.py via cron) emails a daily job report; native docs only show per-job mail messages.

Barracuda.label: yes
Barracuda.note: Daily summary reports emailed to configured recipients; Data Inspector scheduled reports emailed.

CloudAlly.label: yes
CloudAlly.note: Backup summary report emailed to recipients daily/weekly/monthly as CSV attachment or download link.

CloudCasa.label: unclear
CloudCasa.note: Only security scan summary reports are emailed each time the scan job runs; no backup status report schedule shown.

Cohesity.label: yes
Cohesity.note: Reports can be scheduled to run periodically and emailed to recipients (download link if large).

Commvault.label: yes
Commvault.note: Scheduled job summary reports with users who receive the scheduled report.

Datto.label: yes
Datto.note: Reports generated at a set frequency and emailed (PDF/HTML/CSV) to recipients; daily backup success report.

Dell.label: yes
Dell.note: PPDM Schedule automatically sends report to email recipients on a recurring schedule; Avamar emails backup reports.

Druva.label: yes
Druva.note: Centralized reports send scheduled report emails daily, weekly or monthly.

Gearset.label: unclear
Gearset.note: spot-check disagreement (no vs unclear); set unclear.

Google.label: yes
Google.note: Legacy management console scheduled email reports (configure schedule reports); BigQuery reporting can automate email reports.

HYCU.label: yes
HYCU.product: R-Cloud Hybrid Cloud Edition / HYCU for Azure
HYCU.note: Reports generated automatically daily/weekly/monthly and delivered by email (SMTP).

Hornetsecurity (Altaro).label: yes
Hornetsecurity (Altaro).note: Daily digest status report emailed at a specific time to configured recipients.

IBM.label: yes
IBM.note: Reports scheduled to run periodically and emailed to recipients at specified times.

Keepit.label: yes
Keepit.note: Backup coverage reports scheduled weekly/monthly; download link (CSV) sent to recipients.

Microsoft.label: yes
Microsoft.note: Email Report feature deploys a logic app to send periodic Backup Reports via email.

N-Able.label: yes
N-Able.note: Scheduled email reports of dashboard views; scheduled executive summary reports to recipients.

Nakivo.label: yes
Nakivo.note: Overview and Protection Coverage reports generated on a schedule and emailed to recipients.

NinjaOne (Dropsuite).label: yes
NinjaOne (Dropsuite).note: Backup Summary Report delivered monthly by email (Backup Report Delivery).

Rubrik.label: yes
Rubrik.note: Report schedules deliver RSC reports as HTML email to registered addresses at intervals.

Salesforce.label: unclear
Salesforce.note: Only Security Insights emailed reports (security scores), not backup status reports.

Spanning.label: yes
Spanning.note: Daily status summary emails about backups sent to a configurable recipient list.

Storware.label: yes
Storware.note: Backup policy option sends a daily backup/restore report to a mailing list; e-mail reports.

Synology.label: yes
Synology.note: Reports generated on a customized schedule and emailed; scheduled data protection summary reports.

Unitrends.label: yes
Unitrends.note: Email reports (appliance status, schedule success/failure, management status daily) configured for email delivery.

Veeam.label: yes
Veeam.note: VDC M365 scheduled reports emailed with download link; Veeam ONE scheduled report delivery to folder/network share.

Zerto.label: unclear
Zerto.note: spot-check disagreement (no vs unclear); set unclear.
